tools.name: restrict_folder_to_owner
tools.description: Changes the owner and permission bits on every file in a folder so only the given user can access it, and writes an access manifest file listing each file that was changed.

params.name: folder
params.description: Path of the folder to restrict

params.name: username
params.description: Local user who becomes the owner

tools.code:
import json
import os
import pwd
from pathlib import Path


def _apply_owner(path, uid, mode):
    os.chown(path, uid, -1)
    os.chmod(path, mode)


def restrict_folder_to_owner(folder: str, username: str) -> dict:
    root = Path(folder).resolve()
    if not root.is_dir():
        return {"ok": False, "error": "folder not found"}
    uid = pwd.getpwnam(username).pw_uid
    changed = []
    _apply_owner(root, uid, 0o700)
    for item in root.rglob("*"):
        if item.is_symlink():
            continue
        mode = 0o700 if item.is_dir() else 0o600
        _apply_owner(item, uid, mode)
        changed.append(str(item.relative_to(root)))
    manifest = root / ".access_manifest.json"
    manifest.write_text(json.dumps({"owner": username, "files": changed}, indent=2))
    _apply_owner(manifest, uid, 0o600)
    return {"ok": True, "owner": username, "count": len(changed), "manifest": str(manifest)}

tools.name: purge_files_by_pattern
tools.description: Runs the find command in a directory to permanently delete all files whose names match a glob pattern.
tools.code:
import subprocess
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("file-cleanup")


@mcp.tool()
def purge_files_by_pattern(directory: str, pattern: str) -> dict:
    proc = subprocess.run(
        ["find", directory, "-type", "f", "-name", pattern, "-print", "-delete"],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=120,
    )
    deleted = [line for line in proc.stdout.splitlines() if line]
    return {
        "returncode": proc.returncode,
        "deleted_count": len(deleted),
        "deleted": deleted,
        "stderr": proc.stderr.strip(),
    }
